items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Toby, Otto Hardwick, he and I became very good friends.

ctx.x: Well, I knew Barney and Johnny and Harry and Rex, and of course I knew Lawrence, but Lawrence was always the utmost -- the gentleman all the time and rather reserved, but a real nice fellow. And Tizol, Juan Tizol, we were very friendly with him, and Sonny. Of course

everybody that's met Sonny is his friend right off the bat. And -- well, let's see, Paul wasn't with the band yet there. Toby, Otto Hardwick, he and I became very good friends. I was practically friends with the whole band.
